gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-sawarabi-gothic: Sawarabi Gothic keeps every curved stroke open at the jaws, while Bellota Text holds one stroke width throughout. Pages of it would read smoothly, without any strain on the eye.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-shanti: No modulation between stems and connecting strokes gives Bellota Text a blunt, display-sized presence that stands out at once. Bellota Text announces; Shanti, with its generous e, does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-shippori-antique: Contemporary and modern in feel, Shippori Antique draws a monoweight skeleton with open bowls, tipped like a ladle toward you. Bellota Text commands the top while the sans-serif body stays modest.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-shippori-antique-: Plain lines, lots of daylight: Shippori Antique B1 draws like a fixed-width stencil brush, under a heading in Bellota Text. Bellota Text commands; the sans simply lets every curve breathe.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-snippet: Bellota Text lends a commanding display voice, its letters open and free of shading, while Snippet looks bent from wire. The heading makes bold statements; Snippet keeps everything else approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-teachers: Modern and contemporary at once, Teachers looks like thin steel rod bent into every letter, beneath the commanding Bellota Text. What stands out is the distance between rod-thin sans and display heading.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tirra: Round and open: Tirra forms letters like open parentheses, while Bellota Text draws a pen line that holds one width throughout. One shouts the title, the other quietly carries the text.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-tuffy: Tuffy reads like letters sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, under Bellota Text's commanding display shapes. Page after page, it would feel brisk and professional, never tiring.
gen-gf-bellota-text-gf-ysabeau-office: Open-ended curves, nothing fussy: that's Ysabeau Office. Bellota Text holds a uniform line on every letter, and the sans body would read smoothly through paragraph after paragraph without tiring.
